Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner correctly identified from the WebSurfer results that Alfred Balk served under Nelson Rockefeller. However, in the "Updated Understanding" section of the second step, the Planner erroneously concluded that Nelson Rockefeller was a Vice President and associated him with Spiro T. Agnew. This is a factual error: Nelson Rockefeller was the Governor of New York at the time (and later a Vice President under Gerald Ford decades later), but the committee mentioned in the text was specifically "New York Governor Nelson Rockefeller's Committee," not a US Vice President's committee. Furthermore, Spiro Agnew was never associated with Nelson Rockefeller in this context. The Planner failed to verify the title of Rockefeller at the time or correctly interpret the relationship described in the source text.
